headlines.title: Poundland collapses putting 11,000 jobs at risk
headlines.description: The discount chain has collapsed into administration after its owners failed to find a buyer.

headlines.title: US stocks fall further as fears over AI intensify
headlines.description: All three main US indexes were down in early trading, with the tech-dominated Nasdaq down almost 4%.

headlines.title: Energy bills to rise by 26% from January after gas prices surge
headlines.description: A household using a typical amount of energy would see its annual bill rise from £1,723 to £2,166 if this level was sustained for a year.

headlines.title: US announces new tariffs on host of countries including China
headlines.description: The new levies would hit many of America's biggest trading partners, including China and the EU.

headlines.title: US attorney general dodges questions about Nvidia investigation
headlines.description: Nvidia's share price have fallen 7% as lawmakers demand answers about President Donald Trump's involvement in Huang's reinstatement.
